props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the panel. Defaults to a count of what is uploading, failed or complete.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the region. Give each queue on a page its own.

props.name: floating
props.description: Pin the panel to the bottom-right corner of the viewport.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controlled: whether the panel is collapsed to a pill.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Whether the panel starts collapsed, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onClearCompleted
props.description: Removes finished rows. Without it, the button is not shown.
